source.title: Call for Applicants - WQAC Leader (October 2019)
source.content:
There will be an appointment of a new **WCA Quality Assurance Committee (WQAC) Leader**, as Gregor Billing has resigned. We would like to thank Gregor Billing for the work he has done leading the committee. The WQAC has the role of supporting and promoting continuous quality improvement within the WCA. They apply quality standards worldwide to ensure consistent high quality of processes for WCA Staff, Regional Organizations, Competition Organizers, and Competition Staff.

Candidates are expected to fulfill their terms (24 months) and to spend at least 6 hours per week on average to work for the Committee. The qualities expected of candidates are:
- Attention to detail
- Accuracy
- Very good knowledge of the Regulations
- Practical thinking
- Collaboration skills
<!--break-->
The application period for candidates to submit their candidacy documents is from now until **November 15th, 2019, 23:59 UTC**. Interested candidates can send the application privately to the WCA Board (board@worldcubeassociation.org).

The candidacy documents must be in PDF format, and must include:
- Brief personal introduction.
- Summary of activities done for the WCA.
- Ambitions as the WQAC Leader of the WCA.

Candidates are additionally asked to send a copy of their applications which can be made public at the end of the application period.

The rights and duties of the WQAC can be found in [WCA Motion 10.2019.4](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2019.4%20-%20Quality%20Assurance%20Committee.pdf).

After the application period, the WCA Board will make a selection by voting and will announce the new Leader, after confirmation among Senior Delegates and sitting Committee/Team Leaders by voting, as described in Section 4 of [WCA Motion 10.2019.0](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2019.0%20-%20Committees%20and%20Teams.pdf).

Thanks for your candidacies and support.

translation.title: WCA 质量保证委员会招募负责人（2019 年 10 月）
translation.content:
Gregor Billing 已辞职，WCA 将任命新的 **WCA 质量保证委员会（WQAC）负责人**。感谢 Gregor Billing 在带领委员会期间所做的工作。WQAC 负责支持和推动 WCA 持续改进工作质量，在全球实施质量标准，使 WCA 工作人员、地区组织、比赛组织者及比赛工作人员的工作流程保持稳定的高质量。

申请人应能完成 24 个月任期，并平均每周至少投入 6 小时处理委员会事务。我们希望申请人具备：

- 注重细节。
- 工作准确。
- 十分熟悉竞赛规则。
- 思考务实。
- 良好的协作能力。
<!--break-->
申请从即日起开放，截止时间为 **2019 年 11 月 15 日 23:59 UTC**。有意者请私下将材料发送至 WCA 董事会（board@worldcubeassociation.org）。

申请材料须为 PDF 格式，包含：

- 简短的个人介绍。
- 为 WCA 所做工作的概述。
- 担任 WCA 质量保证委员会负责人的工作设想。

另请提供一份可在申请截止后公开的申请材料副本。

WQAC 的权利与职责见 [WCA 议案 10.2019.4](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2019.4%20-%20Quality%20Assurance%20Committee.pdf)。

申请截止后，WCA 董事会将通过投票选出新负责人，并按照 [WCA 议案 10.2019.0](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2019.0%20-%20Committees%20and%20Teams.pdf) 第 4 节，经高级代表及现任委员会、团队负责人投票确认后公布。

感谢大家的申请与支持。
